strapiBlog.title: $953 Million Development - Al Tay Hills Sharjah Unveiled with UAE’s Longest Green River
strapiBlog.short_description: A groundbreaking new project has been launched in Sharjah, redefining upscale living with a sustainable vision.

data.text:
A groundbreaking new project has been launched in Sharjah, redefining upscale living with a sustainable vision. Kuwait Real Estate Company (Aqarat), in collaboration with IFA Hotels and Resorts, has introduced the $953 million real estate development, Al Tay Hills Sharjah.

This upcoming development will span over a vast six million square feet. The highly anticipated project will feature 1,100 elegantly designed villas and townhouses, bringing a new standard of luxury to Sharjah.

About Al Tay Hills Sharjah

Strategically positioned in the Al Tay area near Sharjah Grand Mosque, this development will offer direct access to Emirates Road, ensuring seamless connectivity to Dubai and Sharjah’s key landmarks.

Its prime location places it minutes away from Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai, and Sharjah International Airport, making it an ideal residential choice for professionals and families seeking convenience and tranquility.

The construction of Al Tay Hills Sharjah will be executed in three carefully planned phases, with the first phase slated for completion by the first quarter of 2028.

This phased approach ensures meticulous attention to detail and superior quality in every aspect of the development. Prices for the residences start at AED 1.8 million, reaching up to AED 7.2 million for premium six-bedroom villas, reflecting the project’s commitment to delivering diverse options for investors and homebuyers alike.

Modern Residences with World-Class Amenities

Designed with both comfort and sophistication in mind, Al Tay Hills Sharjah will feature three to six-bedroom villas and townhouses, each boasting a private pool and contemporary architectural design.

The developers, Kuwait Real Estate Company (Aqarat) and IFA Hotels and Resorts, have ensured that the community reflects innovation while maintaining the cultural essence of Sharjah. Homebuyers will enjoy an array of high-end amenities, including children’s and adults' playgrounds, a mosque, restaurants, cafes, retail outlets, and dedicated cycling and walking paths stretching 11 kilometers.

data.text:
Al Tay Hills' Highlight - UAE’s Longest Green River

A central highlight of the development will be the UAE’s longest green river, an impressive 2.5-kilometer stretch of lush greenery designed to serve as the community’s natural lung.

This unique feature enhances the living environment with fresh air, scenic walking paths, and tranquil relaxation spaces. By integrating extensive green landscapes, the project aligns with Sharjah’s commitment to sustainable urban living, offering residents a harmonious blend of nature and modernity.

Investment Appeal and Market Outlook

Kuwait Real Estate Company (Aqarat) and IFA Hotels and Resorts have highlighted the immense potential of the UAE’s real estate sector, with Sharjah emerging as a prime destination for regional and international investors.

The introduction of freehold property ownership for all nationalities has further fueled demand, attracting significant interest in the market. The vision behind Al Tay Hills Sharjah is to set new benchmarks for sustainable and luxury living, catering to the aspirations of both investors and residents.
